text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
/*Destiny has not changed in the 
slightest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
I should have won. But... Opera O and Doto 
were evolving even mid-race, exceeding 
theoretical limits.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
Even if they produced results on the 
Triple Crown route, comparisons with the 
older generation and a lack of rivals 
would lead to them being branded the 
"weakest generation"—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
"...Suddenly, the error in 'Parcae' was 
resolved. The 'worst-case fate' that was 
supposed to have been overturned returns."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
Parcae's calculated outcome indicates 
defeat in the next objective: the Tenno 
Sho (Spring). */
